limitations: This is bounded observation, not a maintenance performance repair or proof of sustained ingestion recovery.
Four is the committed-sample cap, not the attempt count. Rolled-back attempts may consume nontransactional identity values and repeat before the fixed deadline.
Timings cover global maintenance; attachment to the fixed run does not make every helper exclusive to that run.

total_ms ends before audit construction/append and includes telemetry admission separately. Cron elapsed minus measured phases still combines audit overhead, monitor remainder and commit; it cannot be assigned exclusively to one of them.
The observer consumes time. NOWAIT does not eliminate storage/FK/sequence/commit delay, and a real fixture shows added audit work can exhaust the unchanged caller deadline and propagate57014.
Only a successful outer commit retains a sample; failed/cancelled/rolled-back/capped/expired/stronger-isolation calls can leave none. No sample is not evidence of fast maintenance.
Clock checks protect admission/append boundaries, not the time of outer transaction commit. Wall-clock durations are approximate.
New trace rows appear in REF03 evidence and must remain separate from source pages, physical records, readbacks and coverage certification.
